findings.issue: Review gate can pass with contradictory review artifacts. It checks `some artifact verdict === "pass"` and independently checks `some artifact is third_party/heterogeneous/trueCrossEngine`, so a same_source pass artifact plus a third_party revise_required artifact passes. That violates the independent review completion fact: the readable independent review evidence itself must be pass, and failing review artifacts must not be ignored.
findings.recommendation: Require at least one readable artifact that is both independent and `verdict === "pass"`, and reject any readable review artifact whose verdict is `revise_required` or `escalate_to_human`. Add a regression test for same_source/pass + third_party/revise_required.

findings.issue: Phase completion sequence is internally inconsistent. The text says write/update `phase-result.json` before the phase commit, then run phase-gate, and only after gate ok the phase may be marked done. But `scripts/phase-gate.mjs` requires `phaseResult.status === "done"`, so an executor cannot tell whether the gate input is a draft or already-final completion record.
findings.recommendation: Define one executable order. Recommended: state that `phase-result.json` must already contain `status:"done"` as a completion-fact draft before commit/gate, and phase-gate blocks only advancement to the next phase, not the act of setting the field. Update wording and tests/error messages to match.

resolutionSummary: revise_required. Verification commands passed locally: targeted vitest suite 94/94, validate-stage-result PASS, git diff --check PASS. Blocking issues remain in phase-gate review verdict aggregation and build-code gate ordering semantics.

findings.description: Spec describes or requires eliminating internal contradictions between field contracts or rule statements (cluster A: schema/contract terms + cluster B: conflict/contradiction/duplicate terms). Multiple conflicting schemas for the same entity cause silent drift — schema-drift blocking.
